H2-PRISM Physics + AI
Physics-guided Event Attribution & Observability-Gated Framework for Hydrogen Pipelines
✓ Real-Gas Verified Zenodo Record 17871393

Executive Overview & Core Prototype Mission

Traditional pipeline monitoring systems suffer from an acute +90% false alarm rate because normal operational compression and valve maneuvers mimic leak signatures. H2-PRISM resolves this via a 3-tier architecture: (1) Real-Gas Line-Pack Dynamics to prove mass conservation during operational maneuvers, (2) Acoustic Wave Localization (±650m) to physically pin-point breach locations, and (3) 3-Axis Observability Gating (O = min(O_Q, O_S, O_E)) that abstains with an honest UNKNOWN report when data is insufficient, preventing catastrophic false guessing.
